china-1919:p0171_3.rationale: Net value of merchandise consigned from China and Hongkong and retained in the United Kingdom after re-export, 1911-1914; this is trade in goods imported into the UK.

china-1919:p0171_4.rationale: Declared value of merchandise consigned from the United Kingdom to China and Hongkong, 1911-1914; this is UK export trade.

china-1919:p0171_5.rationale: Declared value of registered imports of bullion and specie into the UK from China and Hongkong; this is a trade flow of bullion and specie, not mined output or reserves.

china-1919:p0171_6.rationale: Declared value of registered gold and silver bullion and specie exported from the UK to China and Hongkong; this is trade in goods.
review_questions: The year headings are only partly printed; no source figures were altered.
